title: Leaders In This Phase And Their Contribution
definition: The period 1918-1929 marks the transition from the Gandhian entry into Indian politics to the emergence of radical, socialist, and constitutionalist factions within the Indian National Congress.
importanceInUpsc: This phase is critical for understanding the ideological diversification of the freedom struggle, the rise of the Swarajist party, and the shift from mass movements to parliamentary obstructionism.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Leaders In This Phase And Their Contribution.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
